questions.prompt: What are the values passed to a method called?
questions.explanation: Arguments are the actual values passed to a method. Parameters are the variables in the method definition that receive them.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank: void SetAge(_____ age) { this.age = age; }
Arrange the relationship between parameter definition and argument passing.
What is a parameter in a method definition?
options: A variable that receives the argument
questions.explanation: A parameter is a variable declared in the method signature that receives the passed argument value.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank: void Print(string msg = "Hi") { _____ msg; }
Write a method Add that takes two int parameters and returns their sum. Call it with 10 and 20 and print the result.

options: Specifying the parameter name when calling a method
questions.explanation: Named arguments let you pass values by explicitly naming the parameter: Calculate(x: 10, y: 20);

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank: Greet(name: "Alice", age: _____ );
Arrange the flow of passing an argument to a method.
Can you skip an optional parameter when calling a method?
options: Yes, if it has a default value
questions.explanation: Optional parameters with default values can be omitted; the default is used automatically.
